prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: square transparent PNG exercise pose draft, one adult, one static held pose.
Primary request: seated short-foot arch hold WITHOUT toe flexion. An adult female with athletic shorts sits securely on a simple stable armless chair, pelvis visibly resting on the seat, knees comfortably bent, barefoot feet on the floor. Show the quiet held contraction: the near foot has a subtly elevated normal medial longitudinal arch as the metatarsal heads draw toward the heel. Crucial: heel AND ball of the foot remain planted at the SAME floor level; all toes relaxed, long and uncurled, touching the floor normally. No toe claw, no lifted forefoot, no heel raise, no standing.
Composition: square canvas. Close low three-quarter medial-side view centered on the near bare foot and lower leg, with pelvis resting on chair seat and bent thigh/knee clearly in view to establish sitting. Lower torso through feet is sufficient; crop above lower torso. Near foot large enough for the normal medial arch, heel contact and toe contact to be unambiguous, toes pointing to the right. Far leg and foot are naturally separated behind, also resting on floor; exactly two legs and two feet. Chair support legs lightly drawn; no chair leg intersects the foot. A short thin ground-contact line can clarify foot support. No inset or second diagram.
Style/medium: match WallCrawl's existing restrained exercise art: delicate clean WHITE hollow contour line drawing, natural adult anatomy, a few simple internal anatomical curves and clothing seams, shorts. White outlines only with transparent interiors and transparent background; no white fills, no hatching, no shading, no glow, no colored lines, no dark background rectangle. Smooth simple contours rather than photographic detail.
Constraints: depict only one held seated stage. The arch rise is subtle and anatomically plausible, not a high arched bridge shape. Do not curl the toe joints to shorten the foot. The full heel pad and metatarsal pad stay down. No assisted hand on foot, no equipment at the toes, no band, no towel. No arrows, labels, numbers, exercise dose, logos, text, watermark, pain or therapeutic symbols. This is a factual draft, no efficacy claim. Output a single square image with genuine transparent alpha.
